email_subject: Application - UI Design System & Figma Component Library Internship
email_body:
Dear HMS Networks Team,

I am writing to apply for the UI Design System & Figma Component Library internship. With a background in front-end development (AngularJS) and hands-on experience building WordPress sites, I am eager to contribute to structuring and scaling your design system.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and build/maintain client websites, which has honed my ability to extract, structure, and synthesize information. My project mirook.com involved implementing structured data and technical audits, demonstrating my analytical and problem-solving skills.

I am curious, organized, and comfortable navigating complex systems. I am particularly excited about the opportunity to learn from a senior Information Architect and work within structured methodologies like Lean UX and SAFe. I am available for the full internship duration and am based in Belgium.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear HMS Networks Team,

I am excited to apply for the UI Design System & Figma Component Library internship. Your description of shaping the future of a global industrial platform through design resonates deeply with my passion for creating structured, user-centered digital experiences. With a technical foundation in front-end development and a growing expertise in SEO and content, I am eager to bring my analytical mindset and collaborative spirit to your team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed a keen eye for detail and a systematic approach to problem-solving. I regularly analyze website performance, extract insights from data, and implement improvements—skills that directly translate to analyzing Figma structures and extracting design guidelines. My experience building and maintaining WordPress sites with Elementor and Astra has given me a solid understanding of component-based design and the importance of consistency across a system.

Previously, as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I worked with AngularJS and JavaScript, which gives me a practical understanding of how design systems are consumed by development teams. This background will help me contribute to creating a reliable handover process from Figma to developers.

My project mirook.com showcases my ability to work independently and deliver results: I designed and built a multi-page site, implemented structured data, and ran iterative audits to improve search visibility. This experience taught me to ask the right questions, document clearly, and present work-in-progress effectively.

I am particularly drawn to HMS's culture of trust, empathy, and collaboration. I am eager to learn from your senior Information Architect and contribute to a design system used worldwide. I am available for the full internship duration and am based in Belgium.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
